title_lines: Captions are part of the story
A small error can reverse a claim

post.title: How a Single Caption Error Can Reverse Your Message
post.description: Captions are part of the story — misspelling names, numbers, or words like 'not' or 'never' can flip meaning entirely. Always review creator captions first; if unavailable, verify transcriptions before clipping. From the captioning best practices series.
